 Tracking the House: See which races are still counting votes
 By Curt Merrill , Shikha Subramaniam 
 Updated Nov 3, 2026, 8:14 PM ET 
 PUBLISHED Nov 3, 2026, 4:00 AM ET 
 House election 
 US elections 
 Congressional news 
 See all topics 
 Facebook 
 Tweet

 Vote counting will continue well beyond Election Day, with several key House races still too close for CNN to project a winner. Counting procedures vary by state, meaning some races could be decided quickly while others may take days.
 Related article
 CNN 
 See which House districts have the biggest shifts this midterm election 
 2 min read 
 Below are the House races where CNN has yet to project a winner, along with estimates of the ballots remaining to be counted in each.
 Follow along as results come in — these graphics will update as CNN projects these races.
